definitions.explanation: The firm flesh surrounding the base of the teeth in the mouth.

examples.japanese: {歯|は}を{磨|みが}くときは{歯茎|はぐき}も{一緒|いっしょ}にマッサージする。
examples.english: When brushing my teeth, I also massage my gums.

examples.japanese: {歯茎|はぐき}から{血|ち}が{出|で}るのは{歯周病|ししゅうびょう}のサインかもしれない。
examples.english: Bleeding from the gums may be a sign of gum disease.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんの{歯茎|はぐき}に{歯|は}が{生|は}え{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: Teeth have started growing from the baby's gums.

examples.japanese: {歯茎|はぐき}が{赤|あか}く{腫|は}れていたので、{歯医者|はいしゃ}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: My gums were red and swollen, so I went to the dentist.

examples.japanese: {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}が{進|すす}むと{歯茎|はぐき}が{下|さ}がって{歯|は}がぐらぐらし{始|はじ}めるので、{早|はや}めに{治療|ちりょう}した{方|ほう}がいい。
examples.english: If gum disease progresses, the gums recede and teeth start to become loose, so it's better to get treatment early.

notes:
{歯茎|はぐき} refers to the gums in the mouth. {歯|は} means 'tooth' and {茎|くき/ぐき} means 'stem.'

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {歯茎|はぐき}から{血|ち}が{出|で}る: gums bleed
- {歯茎|はぐき}が{腫|は}れる: gums swell
- {歯茎|はぐき}が{下|さ}がる: gum recession
- {歯茎|はぐき}をマッサージする: to massage gums

DENTAL HEALTH:
- {歯周病|ししゅうびょう}: periodontal disease
- {歯肉炎|しにくえん}: gingivitis
- {歯石|しせき}: tartar

RELATED BODY PARTS:
- {歯|は}: tooth
- {舌|した}: tongue
- {唇|くちびる}: lips
- {口|くち}: mouth
